output.text: The imaginary currency centers on a woven sun, symbolizing shared work and collective effort. A violet border frames the note, representing unity and resilience. On the reverse, nine square windows reveal distinct city districts—each a unique district with its own character and purpose. These windows stand for transparency, opportunity, and interconnected urban life. The woven sun, crafted from gold and silver threads, shifts in appearance with the light, reinforcing collaboration. Together, the a woven sun, nine square windows, and violet border embody community, vision, and shared progress. This design celebrates cooperation, openness, and the strength found in unity.
